BTS Group is awarded the DRIVE AWARD 2017 in Management Category

Mr. Surayut Thavikulwat (Right), Chief Financial Officer, BTS Group Holdings Public Company Limited, was handed over the DRIVE AWARD 2017 in Management Category by Assoc. Prof. Pasu Decharin, Ph.D. (Center), Dean of Faculty of Commerce and Accountancy, Chulalongkorn University, and Mr. Chatchai Payuhanaveechai (Left), President of MBA's Alumni Association, Faculty of Commerce and Accountancy, Chulalongkorn University. The ceremony was held on 29th June 2017 at the Chulalongkorn University Auditorium.

DRIVE AWARD 2017, organised by MBA Chula Alumni Association

The Company was awarded the DRIVE AWARD 2017 in Management Category, organized by MBA Chula Alumni Association. The 32 leading business, organisation and personal groups were selected by considering from their outstanding performance in driving the economy at the macro level effectively to receive the award in 7 catergories consisting of strategic, management, marketing, human resources, finance, local philosopher and community enterprises.

Result of the Corporate Governance Report of Thai Listed Companies conducted by Thai Institute of Directors (IOD)

The Company was one of the 110 companies that received the result of the 2017 corporate governance assessment in the “Excellent” level and was categorized in the 5-star group (assessment scores of 90%-100%) out of 620 listed companies that were assessed for corporate governance. This is the sixth consecutive year that the Company was ranked in the 5-star group since 2012, which is an affirmation that the Company has stood by its principles of good corporate governance for the sustainable development of the organisation.

Result of the Annual General Meeting of Shareholders Quality Assessment conducted by Thai Investors Association (TIA)

This assessment aims to evaluate the quality of the annual general meeting of shareholders held by listed companies based on what listed companies should do before the meeting, on the day of the meeting, and after the meeting. Because the Company has given importance and has striven to improve the quality of the Company’s annual general meeting of shareholders continuously and regularly, the Company received 98 out of 100 scores for the quality of the 2017 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders.
